submitted.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements spread across the line (Sb 0.22, 0.33, 0.47, 0.66 and 0.86), Sb 0.333 gave the highest EQE at 0.0056%. The measurements on both sides of it were lower (0.0021% at 0.22 and 0.0026% at 0.47), so the peak is probably somewhere in the Sb 0.25–0.45 range. The ZnSb2O6-type composition (Sb ≈ 0.67) and the Sb-rich end were weaker.
